body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one enemy within 4 units. It becomes Exposed if it uses the same Action type twice before your next turn.

surges.html: When this Contingency triggers, learn whether the triggering creature has any unused Reactions or maintained effects.
If the chosen creature is Exposed when this Contingency triggers, reduce its gained Defense bonus by 2 instead of 1.

rider.title: REVERSAL CONTINGENCY
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Contingency. Trigger: The chosen creature gains a Defense bonus. Effect: Reduce that bonus by 1 for the triggering Action.
rider.meta: EXPIRES: START OF YOUR NEXT TURN
